**APPROVE** — solely as a bounded, exact-workload capacity/persistence probe. Unknown quota/headroom still blocks any broader move or capacity claim; ABBA remains separately pending.

Freeze and record the immutable hub revision, manifest hash, entry count, individual sizes/hashes, and total ≤4 GiB; abort if the source changes. Write every regular file into newly allocated files—no hardlinks, reflinks, overwrite, or reuse of existing cache objects. Use a previously absent private staging path.

Verify entry count, bytes, hashes, and symlink containment. Fsync files and relevant directories; after verification, use a same-parent atomic **no-replace** rename, failing if the destination exists, then fsync the parent.

On the first ENOSPC, EDQUOT, I/O error, timeout, or verification mismatch: stop staging writes immediately; no retry, cleanup, deletion, or freeing other data. Preserve ROOT, existing caches, and partial staging. Quiesce and record the result before any ABBA lease.

Success proves only that this exact copy completed and verified at that time—not 500 GB usability, free/inode headroom, future soak capacity, or move-everything safety. No additional owner input is needed for this scope.
